name: Fruit Preserves
siboNotes: High sugar content can feed SIBO bacteria; use minimal amounts and avoid varieties with high fructose corn syrup or added fructose.
preparationTips: Choose preserves with equal glucose to fructose ratios when possible
Look for varieties sweetened with table sugar rather than fruit juice concentrates
Check ingredient lists to avoid high FODMAP fruits like apple or pear as main ingredients
Consider making homemade preserves with low FODMAP fruits like strawberries
alternatives: Small amounts of fresh berries with a touch of sugar
nutritionalHighlights: Quick source of carbohydrates and energy
May contain vitamin C if made with citrus fruits
Provides small amounts of antioxidants from fruit
High in added sugars with minimal fiber
